create.name: Glenn Harrold
create.bio:
Glenn Harrold is a British hypnotherapist and meditation teacher whose recorded sessions have reached millions of listeners through apps, downloads and streaming. He has worked as a clinical hypnotherapist for 28 years, seeing clients one to one, and the British Society of Clinical Hypnosis elected him a Fellow in 2011.

His early life was rough. From the age of twelve he often slept on the streets, he was expelled from school at fifteen, and a serious health scare at seventeen, after heavy drinking, pushed him to change course. Before turning to hypnotherapy he earned his living as a guitarist in bars and clubs, and music still runs through his recordings.

He is the author of eight self-help titles, published by Orion in Britain and McGraw Hill in America, including The Answer, on the Law of Attraction, and De-Stress Your Life. His most recent, Awaken & Ascend, tells his own story and then offers meditations for spiritual awakening. His relaxation recording Complete Relaxation received a gold disc from Nielsen in 2006. Today his catalogue of hypnosis and meditation sessions is sold through two apps and as MP3s, and his YouTube channel carries guided sleep, mindfulness and confidence sessions. He lives in the western Algarve in Portugal, where he practises yoga, self-hypnosis and meditation.

books.title: Awaken & Ascend
books.author: Glenn Harrold
books.description: Part memoir, part guide: the story of his turn from a troubled youth to hypnotherapy, followed by meditation practices for raising consciousness and reconnecting with a sense of purpose.

books.title: The Answer: Supercharge the Law of Attraction and Discover the Secret of Happiness
books.author: Glenn Harrold
books.description: A practical how-to on using the Law of Attraction: clarifying what you want, acting on it and finding happiness from within. Comes with a meditation download.

books.title: Create Wealth & Abundance in 8 Simple Steps
books.author: Glenn Harrold
books.description: An eight-step book on prosperity and goal-setting, drawing on his own journey from struggle to success and paired with a hypnosis recording.

books.title: De-Stress Your Life in Seven Easy Steps
books.author: Glenn Harrold
books.description: A short book with an accompanying hypnosis recording on easing the pressures of modern life through relaxation and self-hypnosis.

courses.title: Ultimate Hypnosis & Meditation app
courses.description: Subscription app and website with his full catalogue of more than 260 hypnosis and meditation sessions, weekly live meditations and a members' community. A second app, Relax & Sleep Well, sells sessions one at a time without a subscription.

courses.title: Hypnosis and meditation MP3 downloads
courses.description: His downloadable recordings, including Complete Relaxation, Develop Your Self-Confidence and Learn How To Think Positively, each built around guided relaxation and visualisation.

flags: Possible editorial-stature override: his site reports over 10 million apps/MP3s/books sold and 40 million streams; USA Today listed him among top 10 meditation teachers in 2022. Tier left at local_hero from readable counts.

Health restore: much of his catalogue is relaxation, sleep, confidence, Law of Attraction and spiritual meditation (wellbeing wording, fine under the new rule). Weight-loss, stop-smoking, anti-ageing and addiction products and the insomnia-framed sleep titles' 'overcome sleep disorders' copy are left out or not used. He presents first as a clinical hypnotherapist; owner may judge him too therapy-led.

The MP3 catalogue page used for the downloads item also carries Stop Smoking Forever and Lose Weight Now on the same page; the description names only the wellbeing titles. Owner may prefer to drop this item.
Contact: sales@hypnosisaudio.com is shown on the contact page but written as HTML character entities in the source; treated as obfuscated and not used. The contact form is used.
Book ASINs from his own amazon.co.uk links (Awaken & Ascend B0G5LM1KSR may be the Kindle edition); store set to amazon.co.uk. Amazon not opened.
Photos: YouTube avatar (clear headshot) and glenn-2018.jpg from his about page (small, 252x448). The large version redirects to a 404 page, not followed.
Music page promotes Ali Calderwood and Daniela Broder, who 'work with the sacred plant teachers'; not an item, noted only.
left_out: Lose Weight Now (book and audio), Look Young Live Longer, Sleep Well Every Night (book framed as solving a health complaint), Stop Smoking Forever, Detox Your Life and addiction titles: weight/diet, anti-ageing or condition-led.
Videos: 'Lose Weight Now! Hypnosis', '528 Hz ... DNA Repair & Miracles', insomnia-titled sleep hypnosis videos and '417 Hz ... Resolving Past Traumas' (healing-frequency claims).
Ultimate Hypnosis app link (rebrand.ly shortener) and hypnosisaudio.com shop: not opened; the item uses his own products page.
Insight Timer, Breethe and Aura tracks: platforms not opened.
Relaxation music downloads by Ali Calderwood and Daniela Broder: other artists.
